description: This Java class 'RecentCommands' manages a UI component that displays and handles a list of recently used commands, including adding, displaying as buttons, persisting, and executing commands within a GUI application.

classes.name: RecentCommands
classes.description: Manages a GUI component with buttons for recent commands, including persistence, display, and execution.

classes.name: RecentCommands.Entry
classes.description: Represents a command entry with comparison and equality based on command string.

methods.name: RecentCommands
methods.description: Constructor initializing command list, loading from config or defaults, and setting up command listener.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Loads commands from a string, splitting by delimiter and adding to list.

methods.name: addDefaults
methods.description: Adds a predefined set of default commands to the recent commands list.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a command to the list, updates UI, and persists the list.

methods.name: createButton
methods.description: Creates a JButton for a command with icon and action to execute the command.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the scroll pane containing the command buttons.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the command list into a string for storage.

methods.name: getRecent
methods.description: Retrieves a recent command by index.
